How To Install PES 2022 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures files

PES 22 iso save data Textures file for PSP emulator have been combined into a single file, which when extracted will override the default PSP folder. You just need to follow the simple steps it setup  game below.

Installation Video

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oDQM9XEMHxY

Steps to install PES 2022 PPSSPP – PSP Iso files are:

  1. Install and Open Zarchiver Apk App – used for extracting zip or rar files.
  2. Locate PES 2022 PPSSPP – PSP Iso save data Textures rar file in downloads folder just like in the image below.
  3. Click on it and Options Menu will come up for you to click “Extract” from the options menu list.
  4. Click on the title of folder at the top of Zarchiver app interface – just like i did in the image below.
  5. Further click on Device Memory, also known has phone memory and stop there.
  6. Now click “Extract Icon” to start decompressing or extracting PES 2022 PSP Rar file.
  7. Finally wait till the file is successfully decompressed or extracted, after the progress bar has reached 100%.
  8. Install PPSSPP gold or normal blue edition Apk, allow or give permissions required.
  9. In PSP – PPSSPP emulator app, goto “Games Tab” browse your device Phone Memory and locate PSP Folder, click on it and you will see PES 22 game icon.
  10. Before playing, change PPSSPP – PSP  emulator in App language to Espanol to avoid black screen when loading PES PPSSPP games.
  11. To Change PPSSPP emulator language  to Espanol go to Settings > Click System > Language and then scroll down a little to select Espanol.
